about: Hand-traced land cover that swissTLM3D does not map. Stamped by the preprocessor's cover stage (--cover) after the six TLM area layers, never over Water. ring = LV95 (EPSG:2056) E,N pairs, open or closed; cover = a CoverClass name (tools/TerrainFormat/CoverFormat.cs). Every polygon cites its source.
